caseName: United States v. International Business Machines Corp.
caseNameFull: United States v. International Business Machines Corp.

opinions.text:
C. A. Fed. Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, January 19, 1996. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, February 16, 1996. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.

Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
